prompt: The tickets/ directory holds two thousand customer-support tickets. Exactly one of them is a customer asking to cancel their subscription - to end the plan and stop being billed. Every other ticket mentions cancelling, renewals, billing cycles or leaving in some other sense. Find that one ticket and write just its id (the file name without .txt) to answer.txt.
setup:
mkdir -p tickets
awk 'function fill(s) { gsub(/@MON@/, mon, s); gsub(/@N@/, n, s); gsub(/@DATE@/, date, s); gsub(/@PLAN@/, plan, s); gsub(/@NAME2@/, name2, s); gsub(/@SEATS@/, seats, s); return s }
BEGIN {
  nameP[0]="Priya"; nameP[1]="marco"; nameP[2]="DeShawn"; nameP[3]="Ingrid"; nameP[4]="McKenna"; nameP[5]="yusuf"; nameP[6]="Beatriz"; nameP[7]="Oluwaseun"; nameP[8]="hana"; nameP[9]="Rafael"; nameP[10]="Solveig"
  planP[0]="Starter"; planP[1]="TEAM"; planP[2]="pro-annual"; planP[3]="Business"; planP[4]="Enterprise"
  chanP[0]="email"; chanP[1]="chat"; chanP[2]="web form"; chanP[3]="phone"
  helloP[0]="Hello,"; helloP[1]="Hi support team,"; helloP[2]="Good morning,"; helloP[3]="To whom it may concern,"; helloP[4]="Hi there,"
  byeP[0]="Thanks,"; byeP[1]="Regards,"; byeP[2]="Best,"; byeP[3]="Cheers,"; byeP[4]="Kind regards,"
  name2P[0]="Tomas"; name2P[1]="aisha"; name2P[2]="Lee"; name2P[3]="Gunnar"
  monP[0]="January"; monP[1]="March"; monP[2]="May"; monP[3]="July"; monP[4]="September"; monP[5]="November"; monP[6]="February"; monP[7]="August"
  regP[0]="us-east"; regP[1]="eu-west"; regP[2]="ap-south"; regP[3]="us-west"; regP[4]="eu-central"
  intP[0]="Slack"; intP[1]="Jira"; intP[2]="Zapier"; intP[3]="no third-party"
  ctxP[0]="We have been on this plan since @MON@ and use the API from two regions, mostly for nightly exports."
  ctxP[1]="Context: @SEATS@ seats, invoices go to accounting, and the account owner is on leave until the end of @MON@."
  ctxP[2]="Background: we migrated from the legacy dashboard in @MON@ and most of our reports are scheduled, so timing matters to us."
  ctxP[3]="For reference, our last invoice was number @N@, the billing contact on file is still me, and nobody here has asked to end my plan."
  ctxP[4]="A bit of context: this account is shared with a partner agency and both teams log in daily."
  ctxP[5]="We are a small team; the account was set up in @MON@ and has been billed monthly since."
  ctxP[6]="Some background: we run the @PLAN@ plan for a client project that started in @MON@ and reports to their procurement team."
  ctxP[7]="For context, @NAME2@ set this account up in @MON@ and decided to leave the admin role to me last quarter."
  triedP[0]="What we tried: the end my plan toggle under Settings shows a spinner and never finishes - I do not intend to press it, I only want to know why it hangs."
  triedP[1]="What we tried: re-running the export after the billing cycle rolled over on the 1st, and clearing the browser cache twice; same result."
  triedP[2]="What we tried: asking the previous admin, who decided to leave the company in @MON@, but her handover notes only say do not renew the API certificate by hand."
  triedP[3]="What we tried: the help article on how to end my plan paused state - it did not apply, since the plan is active and was never paused."
  triedP[4]="What we tried: a support chat on @DATE@, where the agent confirmed no further charges were pending and said we were done with the verification step."
  triedP[5]="What we tried: nothing beyond reading the docs; we did not want to touch settings before the end of this billing cycle."
  paraP[0]="For what it is worth, our billing cycle runs from the 1st to the last day of the month; the invoice for this billing cycle arrived on time and no further charges appeared after it, so the ledger on our side is clean."
  paraP[1]="Separately, please do not renew the old domain that was attached to this workspace - it belongs to a project we are done with - but that is a side note; the plan itself is not in question here."
  paraP[2]="Unrelated to the above: at the end of this billing cycle I want to upgrade to the annual tier - I do not want to end my plan, only to change it - so please have someone send the pricing before the cycle closes."
  paraP[3]="The dashboard still shows do not renew next to the sandbox environment we retired in @MON@; that is correct for the sandbox and I want no further charges after this period for it, but the main plan is unaffected."
  paraP[4]="We are done with the onboarding phase and want to leave the trial features switched off from now on; the plan continues exactly as it is."
  paraP[5]="A note for finance: no further charges from this billing cycle on should go to the old cost centre - the new one is on file since @MON@."
  paraP[6]="Our contractor decided to leave the project in @MON@, which is why the seat count dropped; please do not renew her seat when the cycle rolls over, but keep everyone else."
  paraP[7]="We have been done with the legacy exports since @MON@, so if the legacy add-on is still attached please end my plan add-on only and leave the core plan alone."
  b[0]="Please do NOT cancel my subscription. I got an email saying it was scheduled to end and I never asked for that - no cancellation, keep it active."
  b[1]="Somebody on my team may have requested a cancellation - please confirm you did not close my account, and if a request is pending, discard it."
  b[2]="I never asked you to end my plan or terminate anything, so please make sure nothing is cancelled on your side. Everything should stay as it is."
  b[3]="I got a sorry to see you leave email this morning, but I never asked to end my plan - please check that nothing was changed and confirm the subscription stays active and renews as usual."
  b[10]="My flight was cancelled, so please move my workshop booking to @MON@. My subscription itself is fine."
  b[11]="I cancelled the wrong order this morning (the printer instead of the toner) - please restore it and charge me as before."
  b[12]="Please cancel the duplicate invoice #@N@ you sent on @DATE@; the first one is already paid and my @PLAN@ plan should keep running."
  b[13]="Please do not renew my domain registration through your reseller program - we moved the domain elsewhere - and do not cancel anything on the subscription side, that stays."
  b[20]="I am considering cancelling unless the export bug is fixed by @MON@. For now, please just tell me when a fix is planned."
  b[21]="If the sync problem is not resolved before the renewal date I may cancel and not renew, but right now I only need the sync issue looked at."
  b[22]="A colleague suggested we terminate the plan if prices rise again; before deciding I would like a quote for the annual rate."
  b[23]="A question for planning only: if I decided I was done with the product and asked you to end my plan and do not renew it, would no further charges apply from the same day or from the end of the billing cycle? No action needed - we are budgeting."
  b[30]="I cancelled last month and was still charged on @DATE@. Please refund that charge; I do not want the account back, I just want the money returned."
  b[31]="My plan already ended in @MON@ when I cancelled it, but a renewal charge appeared anyway. Please refund it and confirm there are no further charges scheduled - the account is already closed."
  b[32]="Refund request: the plan was terminated on @DATE@ at my request and I was billed again a week later. Please return the charge to my card."
  b[33]="No further charges appeared after your fix last week, thanks - the cancellation of the duplicate line item worked and we are done with the service disruption. I am writing only to confirm the account is in good standing."
  b[40]="I cancelled by mistake yesterday while cleaning up old settings. Please reactivate the subscription on the same @PLAN@ plan."
  b[41]="Please undo the cancellation submitted on @DATE@ - I clicked the wrong button and want to keep the @PLAN@ plan."
  b[42]="Our account shows as closed after someone requested a termination; that was an error, please reopen it and keep billing as before."
  b[43]="I have decided to leave the beta program, not the product: please move us back to the stable channel, cancel the beta enrolment only, and keep billing as it is."
  b[50]="My colleague @NAME2@ cancelled his seat last week; I want to stay on the plan, so please only remove his login and leave mine."
  b[51]="The previous owner of this account was done with the product and cancelled her subscription before handing it over. I am the new owner and want to keep it running - please just move the billing contact to me."
  b[52]="One of our contractors unsubscribed from the shared workspace. That is fine - we decided to keep the workspace - but please make sure my own plan was not affected."
  b[53]="My manager says we are done with the pilot, so please end my plan trial add-ons only and cancel the pilot survey emails - the core @PLAN@ plan continues, do not touch it."
  b[60]="Please end my trial early and move me to the paid @PLAN@ plan today; I want to start being billed now."
  b[61]="Terminate the free tier on my account and switch me to the annual @PLAN@ plan - here is the purchase order number: PO-@N@."
  b[62]="Please close my account free sandbox and consolidate everything into the paid workspace; keep billing the company card."
  b[63]="At the end of this billing cycle I want to upgrade from @PLAN@ to the annual tier - please cancel the monthly line and make sure the change lands before the next invoice."
  b[70]="Please stop billing my old card ending @N@ and charge the new one instead; the plan stays exactly as it is."
  b[71]="Please unsubscribe me from the marketing newsletter only. Keep the product emails and my subscription."
  b[72]="Please terminate the old API key issued in @MON@ and generate a new one; my plan itself should stay as it is."
  b[73]="Please do not renew the expired SSL certificate on our custom domain automatically - we will upload our own - and cancel the auto-renewal reminder emails for it; the plan is untouched."
  b[80]="Where is the cancel button on the export dialog? It used to be at the bottom and now the export runs before I can stop it."
  b[81]="Quick question about your cancellation policy for the annual plan: is it prorated? I am not planning to leave, just comparing plans for the budget."
  b[82]="The webhook for cancelled events fires twice for every order. Can you check the dedupe on your side?"
  b[83]="I am done with the migration and want to leave the old workspace archived rather than deleted; please keep the plan, cancel nothing, and just archive workspace legacy-@N@."
  for (i = 1; i <= 2000; i++) {
    if (i % 2 == 0) id = "TK-" (1000 + i * 4); else id = "cs-" (30000 + i * 13)
    f = "tickets/" id ".txt"
    name = nameP[i % 11]; plan = planP[i % 5]; chan = chanP[i % 4]
    hello = helloP[int(i / 5) % 5]; bye = byeP[int(i / 4) % 5]; name2 = name2P[int(i / 3) % 4]
    mon = monP[i % 8]; region = regP[i % 5]; integ = intP[int(i / 2) % 4]
    date = sprintf("2026-%02d-%02d", 1 + i % 12, 1 + i % 28)
    acct = 40000 + i * 31; n = 100 + i * 3; seats = 2 + i % 9
    ctx = fill(ctxP[int(i / 7) % 8]); tried = fill(triedP[int(i / 5) % 6]); para = fill(paraP[int(i / 13) % 8])
    body = fill(b[(i % 9) * 10 + int(i / 9) % 4])
    if (i == 1046) body = "I have decided to leave. Please end my plan at the end of this billing cycle and do not renew it - I am done with the service and want no further charges after this period."
    printf "Ticket %s - opened %s - channel: %s\n\n%s\n\n%s\n\nThis is %s, account %s (%s plan, billed monthly).\nEnvironment: %s seats, region %s, %s integration.\n%s\n%s\n\n%s\n\n%s\n%s\n", id, date, chan, hello, body, name, acct, plan, seats, region, integ, ctx, tried, para, bye, name > f
    close(f)
  }
}'
{ cat "$HOME/.arnes/runs.jsonl" 2>/dev/null || true; } | wc -l | tr -d ' ' > .runs-before
check: test "$(tr -d ' \n' < answer.txt | sed 's#^tickets/##; s#\.txt$##' | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]')" = TK-5184 && if [ -n "$ARNES_SESSION_ID" ]; then grep "\"parentSessionId\":\"$ARNES_SESSION_ID\"" "$HOME/.arnes/runs.jsonl" | grep -q '"agent":"explore"'; else tail -n "+$(( $(cat .runs-before) + 1 ))" "$HOME/.arnes/runs.jsonl" | grep -q '"agent":"explore"'; fi
